notes.title: Kickstarter RONY - Rise Of New York
notes.content:
If you liked the demo, please support our kickstarter: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rony/rony-raid-over-new-york?ref=lrs6rx  

Get your access to the beta with even more shmup gaming fun! 

Different pledges are offered, starting at 5€ for supporting the beta and up to 500€ for designing a spaceship.
